import re

    """ Extract all lines that start with 'VAR' """
    var_lines = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith("VAR"):
            var_lines.append(line.strip())
    return var_lines

            # Chained assignment
            value = parts[1].strip()

                value = values.get(value.split()[1], None)
        values[var_name] = value
    return values

def find_variables_with_value(values, target_value):
    """ Find and return the names of variables with the given value """
    result = [var for var, val in values.items() if val == str(target_value)]
    return result

    VAR GHTAY = 14673

    VAR AVCOU = VAR QHUJP

    values = parse_assignments(var_lines)
